# netactuate_location (Data Source)

Reads a Location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_location" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip` (String) Public IP address returned by the API.
- `location` (String) Location detected for the caller's current IP address.
- `raw_json` (String) Complete location response as JSON, preserving API fields not modeled as first class attributes.
